items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: for the simple reason Vaughn Monroe had given up his band and told everybody goodby

ctx.x: Of course not, what did he have to do. He had nothing to do with that. All I know is, with 5 1/2 million people in the Army at that particular time, there's no way

in the world that I would have treated a dog like the United States Army treated Lester Young and I can get it from Jefferson, Missouri; I can get it from the Adjutant General; I can get it from anywhere. What they did for Lester Young was unspeakable, because it became a personal thing. But you must remember this, Milt, you remember how they used to have a slogan, "Break up the Yankees"? Well, they had a slogan, "Break up Basie". So now if we can get Buck Clayton, if we can get Jack Washington - get the key…
But Buck Clayton had a very fine position in the Army.
